fbd_comment_desc: A note on the diagram; it is not executed
fbd_runs_event: The diagram runs when an input changes
fbd_empty_hint: Drag blocks from the left onto the canvas and connect an output with an input
fbd_no_diagram: This script does not contain a function block diagram
The connection refers to a missing block: The connection refers to a missing block or pin
Types do not match: %s cannot be connect: Types do not match: %s cannot be connected to %s
Input %s is connected more than once: Input %s is connected more than once
Loop without a block that stores a value: Loop without a block that stores a value: %s
Timers need the cyclic mode, in the even: Timers need the cyclic mode, in the event mode they only run when an input changes
fbd_desc_AND: AND: true if all inputs are true
fbd_desc_OR: OR: true if any input is true
fbd_desc_XOR: Exclusive OR: true for an odd number of true inputs
fbd_desc_R_TRIG: Rising edge: true for one cycle when the input becomes true
fbd_desc_F_TRIG: Falling edge: true for one cycle when the input becomes false
fbd_desc_TON: On delay: Q becomes true when IN was true for PT
fbd_desc_TOF: Off delay: Q stays true for PT after IN became false
fbd_desc_TP: Pulse: a rising edge of IN gives a pulse of length PT
fbd_desc_STATE_OUT: Writes an ioBroker state when the value changes
